diff_summary: Extracted the typed simulation tick persistence helper, consolidated session state checks, and canonicalized login_limiter.py formatting without changing its AST.

verification.command: .venv/bin/python -c "import ast,subprocess; p='backend/app/main.py';s=open(p).read();ns=[n for n in ast.parse(s).body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name in ('simulation_loop','_persist_simulation_tick')];assert len(ns)==2;subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/ruff','check','--select','C901','--stdin-filename',p,'-'],input=chr(10).join(ast.get_source_segment(s,n) for n in ns),text=True,check=True)" && .venv/bin/ruff check backend/app/login_limiter.py && .venv/bin/ruff format --check --output-format concise backend/app/main.py backend/app/login_limiter.py && .venv/bin/python .agent/check-format-progress.py backend/app/login_limiter.py
